lists.acer-ar55ar2851udpro:
# Acer AR55AR2851UDPRO 55" (SCBC device R4, Realtek rtd2851m), India, Android TV 14, firmware UKR1.260308
# Build UKR1.260308, incremental 3272 (the R4G 50" note's set is 5597)
#
# Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/acer-ar55ar2851udpro/debloat.txt
# Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/acer-ar55ar2851udpro/debloat.txt
# Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.
#
# Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (Android TV, not Google TV: launcherx is not installed).
# HDMI and AV inputs: com.apps.passthrough. Live TV: com.apps.livetv with com.apps.atv / com.apps.dtv.
#
# Not the same as the Acer R4G 50" in docs/devices/acer-r4g.md (MOKA R4_GTV, Google TV 14), although the
# build is the same. Boot runs Acer's own com.apps.tvsettings/.ui.FallbackHome, and nothing came back:
# after three cold boots (power cable out for 30 s) all 28 packages below stayed disabled, including ten that
# the R4G firmware re-enables at every boot (play.games, feedback, gdpr, esticker, tvmanager, meeting.service,
# timeclock, audiolink, scast, fastscreen). No RecoveryActivity in logcat.
#
# setupwraith owns the saved Wi-Fi network on this set (dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'): leave it enabled.
# Port 5555 opened with `adb tcpip 5555` after Wireless debugging pairing stayed open across all three cold boots.
#
# The remote's YouTube button never reaches Android: com.realtek.keyinterceptserver takes it (keycode 2030) and
# starts com.google.android.youtube.tv by package, so app_keys cannot remap it. With YouTube disabled, every press
# crashes that persistent service (ActivityNotFoundException); Android restarts it at once and nothing else
# breaks. Comment out the YouTube line below if you want the button to work.
#
# New launcher: see README.md and config.json here. Home stays on tvlauncher with set-home-activity, so the
# launcher takes the Home button through HOME_KEY_SERVICE with stock_home_redirect (tvlauncher stays enabled).
#
# Kept on purpose: com.realtek.leanbacklauncher.partnercustomizer (supplies the Inputs button on tvlauncher,
#   as on the Compac ATV R2), com.apps.passthrough, com.apps.smartmenu (picture menu), the key handlers
#   (com.apps.smartkey, com.apps.virtualkey, com.mk.tv.fivekey, com.realtek.keyinterceptserver,
#   com.realtek.android.globalkeyhandler, com.apps.bluetoothremote), com.apps.sys, com.mk.service.tvmidware,
#   firmware updates (com.apps.ota, com.apps.authota), Assistant, Chromecast, Netflix, Prime Video, Backdrop.
# Not touched: com.apps.factory.ui and com.realtek.factorytools (never started), com.apps.biz.ds and
#   com.apps.biz.mt (unclear), com.seraphic.hbbtv.app, com.apps.usbmediaplayer.
#
# Tested on one set on 2026-10-24, in three batches with a Home screenshot after each, then a cold boot:
# Home, HDMI input, Prime Video, Assistant mic, casting, Home/Back/volume/Settings keys work. Then five more
# packages (Play Movies, speed test, partner setup, basic screensaver, TalkBack) and two more
# cold boots, with the new launcher on Home. AdGuard Private DNS validates and Prime Video plays with it.
# Fresh, not yet lived with for days; update it if something breaks.

lists.alwtniet-hy320-mini:
# Alwtniet HY320 Mini projector (device adt3, Askey; Allwinner/HTC firmware), Android 11 (SDK 30)
# Firmware UI_Veng.projector.20250117.194417, 1280x720 panel, ~1 GB RAM (ro.config.low_ram=true).
# Same firmware family as examples/portronics-beem-470/ and examples/magcubic-hy300-pro/, older build.
# The firmware reports the generic "ADT-3" / "adt3" / askey identity: match on the build string,
# or on ro.product.model=HY320Mini.
#
# Apply:   TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/disable.sh examples/alwtniet-hy320-mini/debloat.txt
# Undo:    TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/restore.sh examples/alwtniet-hy320-mini/debloat.txt
# Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Applied 2026-10-21 and lived with since: Wi-Fi, the
# remote, YouTube and Spotify keep working, and the launcher (STOCK_LAUNCHER=none) owns Home.
#
# Getting ADB: Settings > About > press OK on "Build number" seven times. This firmware says
# "Setup mode turned on" rather than "You are now a developer". Developer options is then under
# System; USB debugging opens port 5555. ro.adb.secure=1 (the Allow prompt appears).
#
# Kept on purpose:
# - com.htc.htcsettings: the projector's own settings (keystone, focus, picture).
# - com.htc.closedialog: the power-button menu (it holds REBOOT and SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW).
# - com.hotack.writesn: factory serial/MAC writer that starts at boot. Left alone here, as
#   disabling it while connected over Wi-Fi risks losing the connection.
# - com.android.nfx (NFXAccessibility, v1.1.3, updated in /data): left on here; the Portronics list
#   disables it without issues.
# - com.htc.htclauncherhighenglishd08: the stock Home. build-and-install.sh does not recognise it, so
#   run it with STOCK_LAUNCHER=none; set-home-activity takes Home and the stock one stays as fallback.
#
# Firmware notes:
# - The panel is 1280x720 but ships at density 240, which gives apps an 853x480dp screen. TV apps and
#   the launcher are laid out for 960x540dp: `wm density 213` (undo: `wm density reset`) fixes the
#   cramped layout.
# - Low-RAM device (about 30 MB free with apps running), yet Android still allowed a notification
#   listener (`cmd notification allow_listener`).
# - The unit arrived with unofficial streaming apps in the user partition, not the system image
#   (HDO Box, a "Cinema HD" build as com.yoku.marumovie.analytics, Sports Zone, UKTurks, StreamFire,
#   Drama Player). A factory reset removes them; they are not listed here because this list only
#   disables. com.hotack.silentsdk (the dropper on some H713 units) is not present on this build.

# HTC ad overlay, telemetry and app store
com.htc.expandsdk                      # starts at boot, draws over apps (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW) and uses the internet
com.htc.eventuploadservice             # usage/event uploader
com.htc.storeos                        # HTC app store

# Firmware updaters, disabled on the tested set (uncomment all three to do the same): this unbranded Allwinner/HTC firmware takes OTA images from
# an unknown vendor server, and projectors in this H713 family have shipped firmware with preinstalled
# droppers and adware, so this owner chose no silent firmware changes. Re-enable all three to check
# for firmware updates.
# com.htc.htcotaupdate
# com.softwinner.update                # Allwinner OTA
# android.rockchip.update.service      # Rockchip updater left in this Allwinner image

# Factory and burn-in test apps
com.htc.hyk_test
com.softwinner.agingdragonbox
com.softwinner.dragonbox
com.softwinner.dragonatt

# Preloaded store for another brand's devices
com.huawei.appmarket                   # Huawei AppGallery, installed in the user partition on this unit
lists.anker-nebula-mars-3-air:
# Anker Nebula Mars 3 Air projector, model D2325 (build name Nebula_Mars_2_V2, device taihang,
# ANKER board, MediaTek m7332), Google TV 14 / Android 14 (SDK 34), build UKNV.260210.001.
# No tuner: live_tv_package stays "" and the Inputs menu lists HDMI 1 / HDMI 2 only.
#
# Apply:   TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/disable.sh examples/anker-nebula-mars-3-air/debloat.txt
# Undo:    TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/restore.sh examples/anker-nebula-mars-3-air/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
# Everything is DISABLED for user 0, never uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.
#
# Google TV 14 Home quirk (the important one): while the setup wizard (setupwraith) is enabled,
# cmd package set-home-activity prints Success but Home still resolves to setupwraith/.RecoveryActivity,
# so the new launcher never comes up (the same behaviour as xiaomi-tv-a-pro-2026). Disable it before
# build-and-install.sh disables the stock home; the wizard is only used for first-time setup, and
# restore.sh brings it back. Re-enable it before a factory reset. Unlike the D2426 Capsule
# (anker-nebula-d2426, where setupwraith owns the Wi-Fi but never claims Home), here it owned only
# one old hidden network that was no longer connected; the network in use belongs to android.uid.system
# and kept working after the disable, verified live before proceeding. Phone casting kept working too.
# On other Google TV units the Cast receiver loses its credentials with setupwraith gone and phone
# casting fails with "Untrusted device" (docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) - re-enable setupwraith if your phone
# refuses to cast.
#
# Re-enabled by the firmware at every boot (checked with one reboot on 2026-10-22):
# com.google.android.katniss (Assistant) comes back enabled, the same behaviour as anker-nebula-d2426.
# This owner keeps it on, so the mic button works and nobody re-disables it after each boot.
# To keep it off instead, uncomment com.google.android.katniss and com.google.android.tv.assistant
# below and run Apply again (disable.sh records them first, so Undo brings them back); after each
# boot, tools/check.py --fix <this file> re-disables what came back.
#
# Already disabled at the factory: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter, com.google.android.marvin.talkback.
#
# Remote buttons on this firmware (dumpsys window policy, mKeyMapping): the gear button's
# KEYCODE_NOTIFICATION (83) is consumed by GlobalKeyManager for the stock launcherx, and the Netflix
# button's KEYCODE_BUTTON_4 by com.mediatek.tv.service's NetflixKeyReceiver - both mapped by the
# static overlay com.mediatek.android.tv.globalkeyoverlay, which no shell command can turn off
# (cmd overlay disable throws a SecurityException, and disabling the package changes nothing: static
# overlays ignore package state). Neither key ever reaches an app, so com.netflix.ninja stays ENABLED
# for the Netflix button (it is in the launcher's dock instead), and Settings is the gear pill in
# the launcher's top bar (top_menu in the config.json here). Keep the launcher's key-filtering
# services off (key_filter false, no INPUT_KEY_SERVICE / HOME_KEY_SERVICE build flags): on this
# firmware any bound key service turns ramping volume into one step per press.
#
# DO NOT DISABLE on this model (projector hardware, inputs, remote):
# com.mediatek.tvinput                       # HDMI input service
# com.mediatek.tv.service                    # TV service, global keys, Netflix key receiver
# com.google.android.tv.inputplayer          # HDMI passthrough player
# com.mediatek.tv.inputplayeroverlay         # HDMI overlay
# com.oceanwing.receiver                     # remote control, Nebula IME, accessibility, screen control
# com.zhixin.nebulasmart                     # remote events, accessibility service
# com.zhixin.remoteautopair                  # Bluetooth remote auto-pairing
# com.oceanwing.nebulalinker                 # device info, custom shutdown, firmware update dispatch
# com.zhixin.apphelper                       # package install helper, HTML viewer
# com.zhixin.projector.settings              # picture / focus / keystone / battery / update UI
# com.zhixin.nebulasetupwizard               # Nebula first-run wizard (not Google's setupwraith)
# com.mediatek.wwtv.mediaplayer              # USB media player
# com.mediatek.wwtv.webview                  # webview the settings apps use
# com.dolby.android.audio.service            # Dolby audio processing
# com.google.android.inputmethod.latin       # the on-screen keyboard
# com.google.android.tv.remote.service, Play Store and Play Services
# Factory tools left alone and never opened: com.zhixin.factorytest, mediatek.factorymenu.ui

# --- Telemetry and feedback ---
com.google.android.feedback                  # Google feedback / bug reports
com.android.tv.feedbackconsent               # feedback consent prompt
com.android.adservices.api                   # Privacy Sandbox ad services
com.android.federatedcompute.services        # federated learning
com.android.ondevicepersonalization.services # on-device ad personalisation
com.google.android.partnersetup              # partner-app attribution

# --- Retail / store demo ---
fusion.android.tv.demo                       # RetailDisplay store demo
com.zhixin.nebularetailmode                  # Nebula retail demo mode (boot receiver)

# --- Off by owner's choice (comment out to keep) ---
com.waxrain.airplaydmr_OW                    # AirPlay / DLNA receiver (Chromecast built-in stays)
com.spotify.music                            # Spotify
com.wbd.stream                               # Max (HBO)
com.google.android.videos                    # Google TV buy/rent movies app

# --- Re-enabled after trying, left as comments (see header) ---
# com.google.android.katniss               # Assistant: the firmware re-enables it at every boot; the
#                                          # owner keeps it on so the mic button works
# com.google.android.tv.assistant           # Assistant LED service, same reason
# com.netflix.ninja                        # the remote's Netflix button needs it (MediaTek global-key
#                                          # layer); it is in the launcher's dock instead
# com.google.android.apps.tv.dreamx        # Google Ambient Mode: disabled with the screensaver
#                                          # switched to com.android.dreams.basic/.Colors first,
#                                          # re-enabled on request the same day and made the active
#                                          # screensaver again. To disable it: switch the screensaver
#                                          # first (settings put secure screensaver_components
#                                          # com.android.dreams.basic/.Colors), then uncomment.

# --- Setup wizard: Google TV 14 gives Home to its RecoveryActivity otherwise (see header) ---
com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith

# --- Stock home screen (only after the new launcher is installed: launcher/build-and-install.sh) ---
com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx        # stock Google TV home
com.mediatek.android.leanbacklauncher.partnercustomizer  # partner rows for the stock home

# AQUA MatrixTV EE 50" 4K (Haier, ro.product.model "AQUA MatrixTV EE", product AQ9676EU, device omonia),
# Google TV 14 (API 34), firmware UKN7.260716.049, MediaTek (CVTE-family board: com.cvte.tv.at,

# Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/aqua-matrixtv-ee-50/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
# Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.
#
# Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (.home.HomeActivity); the install script disables it.
# Live TV: com.cltv.hybrid (Anoki "LiveTV", AnokiTvInputService). HDMI 1-4 = com.mediatek.tis/.HdmiInputService/HW2-HW5,
# AV = com.mediatek.tis/.CompositeInputService/HW6, DVB tuner = com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.dvbtuner/.DvbTvInputService/HW0.
# Already disabled from the factory: com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.isdbtuner, com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.atsctuner,
# ru.haier.evo, com.haier.apps.evoSmart, com.mediatek.tv.oneworld.tvcenter, it.hon.onboarding.

# (cmd wifi forget-network) before setupwraith was disabled. The network in use belonged to android.uid.system.
#
# Tested on 24 October 2026 on one set, including two reboots, with the real remote. Same-day test, not a
# multi-day soak. Order used: this whole list (setupwraith included) while launcherx still owned Home, then
# launcher/build-and-install.sh, which disables launcherx once the new launcher is running.
# The home screen was launcher/ from this repo; config.json beside this list has its dock and the gear key.
# Network ADB on 5555 survived a reboot on this set (service.adb.tcp.port=5555), Wireless debugging was on too.
# com.haier.gamingbar comes back enabled at every boot (seen on the first reboot), so it is commented out below.
#
# Remote ("SmartTV-RC Consumer Control", BLE HID): Netflix, YouTube, Input and Mic keep working with no helper
# (com.mediatek.tv.agent and Haier global-key receivers). The YouTube Music button opens YouTube Music, which
# forwards into YouTube on this build. The Prime Video button goes to Prime Video (disabled here, so nothing).

# Do not use scancode 240: the YouTube Music (0x0c00cb) and Prime Video (0x0c00a6) buttons share it.
# HomeKeyService costs the volume ramp (one step per press while held), the trade in
# docs/devices/tcl-55p71b-g09-key-repeat.md; the owner of the test set kept the gear.

# - com.mediatek.autopair, com.haier.bt_pair_tips, com.google.android.tv.googletvremotepairer: remote pairing.
# - com.telink.lt: remote (Telink BLE) firmware, also claims HOME at priority 0.
# - com.cvte.tv.at, com.cvte.autobacklight, com.at.factory.androidtvaidlservice, mediatek.factorymenu.ui: factory - never open.
# - com.mediatek.tis, com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.dvbtuner, com.cltv.hybrid, com.cltv.mal, com.mediatek.tv.agent,
#   com.mediatek.extservice (CEC), com.mediatek.tv.settings, com.google.android.tv.inputplayer, com.mediatek.wwtv.mediaplayer,
#   com.mediatek.tv.oneworld.wizardkt (channel scan), tv.mopa.ginga.
# - By owner choice on the test set: Assistant (katniss), Chromecast (mediashell), Miracast, system updater, Ambient (dreamx),

com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom                # Prime Video, not used

id.visionplus.android.atv                        # Vision+, not used

#   options, but a cable to a computer enumerates nothing, so there is no ADB over USB.
# - The saved Wi-Fi network is owned by setupwraith (`dumpsys wifi | grep cname=`). Forget the network

#   so the stock launcher was the only thing answering it and it does nothing once launcherx is

#   reports is keyCode 83 / scanCode 240, as on the PEAQ AI PONT unit in #853. Its Netflix and YouTube

#   onKeyEvent logged the gear (keyCode=83 scanCode=240) twice and **no volume event of any kind**,
